limits: No learned model or efficacy evaluation; CPUs counts/majority/finite lookup only, all labels independently recomputed.
Standalone full-table value counts are input features; no gold final support is an input shortcut feature.
Exact table intersection legitimately determines final status. Its perfect performance cannot establish dataset usefulness or hidden shortcut leakage.
Required target length/count-bin differences are semantic output consequences. Input character features measured separately.
No statement that every scalar/fact/position frequency is balanced or that all potential shortcuts are excluded.
